_notes: Stranglethorn open-world named-rare loot (2026-10-29). ONE item drops per kill from the rare's pool of four. item_level = creature level + 3. Budget checked by audit() in tools/build_stranglethorn_content.py. Rares are never quested, and nothing here carries magic resistance (the floor for that is level 45) or any crafting material.

Mistvale Longjaw.name: Longjaw's Tooth-Knife
Mistvale Longjaw.flavor_text: Pulled from the front of the jaw, where the old ones go hollow.

Mistvale Longjaw.name: Mangrove-Wader's Boots
Mistvale Longjaw.flavor_text: Laced high. The lagoon floor is mud to the shin and then it is roots.

Mistvale Longjaw.name: Brackwater Hauberk
Mistvale Longjaw.flavor_text: Salt and fresh water both, which is harder on mail than either one alone.

Mistvale Longjaw.name: Still-Water Greaves
Mistvale Longjaw.flavor_text: Nothing in the lagoon moves fast. That is not the same as nothing moving.

Ka'tesh the Last Stairkeeper.name: Stairkeeper's Vinestaff
Ka'tesh the Last Stairkeeper.flavor_text: Cut from the vine that is pulling his temple apart. He uses it anyway.

Ka'tesh the Last Stairkeeper.name: Robes of the Thinning Watch
Ka'tesh the Last Stairkeeper.flavor_text: Cut for a man with a wider back than he has now.

Ka'tesh the Last Stairkeeper.name: Last Keeper's Cowl
Ka'tesh the Last Stairkeeper.flavor_text: There were nine of these made. He is wearing the only one still above water.

Ka'tesh the Last Stairkeeper.name: Crag-Stair Spaulders
Ka'tesh the Last Stairkeeper.flavor_text: The stair goes up the crag in forty turns and he knows every one of them.

Gorbuk the Shelf-King.name: Shelf-King's Roadbreaker
Gorbuk the Shelf-King.flavor_text: One road comes up the shelf. He has stood at the top of it for eleven years.

Gorbuk the Shelf-King.name: Mosh'Ogg Slab Breastplate
Gorbuk the Shelf-King.flavor_text: Three plates where there should be one, lapped and bound with cable.

Gorbuk the Shelf-King.name: One-Road Legplates
Gorbuk the Shelf-King.flavor_text: He did not take the shelf. He was on it when everyone else left.

Gorbuk the Shelf-King.name: Shelf-Climber's Grips
Gorbuk the Shelf-King.flavor_text: Ogre-made for an ogre hand, so there is room in them for two of yours.

Drumhide.name: The Uncrated Tally
Drumhide.flavor_text: A drover's cord with eleven knots on it and no twelfth.

Drumhide.name: Drum-Skin Jerkin
Drumhide.flavor_text: The arena buys hide by the hand-span. This much of it never got to the arena.

Drumhide.name: Drover's Broken Chain
Drumhide.flavor_text: Opened outward. Whatever was in it did not pick the lock.

Drumhide.name: Crate-Hauler's Sabatons
Drumhide.flavor_text: The Flats are bare dirt because of what gets dragged across them.

The Cargo.name: Manifest-Line Claw
The Cargo.flavor_text: The entry read: one crate, livestock, unmarked. The Authority still has the page.

The Cargo.name: Spit-Walker's Vest
The Cargo.flavor_text: Sand gets into the stitching and stays there until the garment gives up.

The Cargo.name: Hood of the Long Walk Back
The Cargo.flavor_text: You can see the whole spit from the root of it. That is the trouble with a spit.

The Cargo.name: Driftwood-Bound Bracers
The Cargo.flavor_text: Hull timber, cut down twice, by two people who did not know each other.

Ssaren the Salvage-Taker.name: Salvage-Taker's Rod
Ssaren the Salvage-Taker.flavor_text: Cut stone comes up off the terraces in pieces and she decides which pieces.

Ssaren the Salvage-Taker.name: Shallows-Sitter's Wrap
Ssaren the Salvage-Taker.flavor_text: Never dry, never quite wet. Whoever wove it knew which it would be.

Ssaren the Salvage-Taker.name: Terrace-Diver's Mantle
Ssaren the Salvage-Taker.flavor_text: Four spans down is the second court. Six is the third. Nobody goes to the fourth.

Ssaren the Salvage-Taker.name: Flooded Court Legplates
Ssaren the Salvage-Taker.flavor_text: Standing in water to the knee all day does to plate what you would expect.

Captain Orlee Vantch.name: Vantch's Shallows Cutlass
Captain Orlee Vantch.flavor_text: Short in the blade. She has never fought anybody on open deck in her life.

Captain Orlee Vantch.name: Three-Wrecks Signet
Captain Orlee Vantch.flavor_text: She put all three on the bars inside a season and the harbour counted every one.

Captain Orlee Vantch.name: Bosun's Weather Coat
Captain Orlee Vantch.flavor_text: Waxed, patched, and warmer than anything else on that beach.

Captain Orlee Vantch.name: Bar-Pilot's Coif
Captain Orlee Vantch.flavor_text: She knows where the sand is. That is the entire trick and it is worth a ship.
